item.title: Einsatz!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Zannendo
  • 発売日: 2009-12-30
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: あいんざっつ!
  • 英語名: Einsatz!

あらすじ

Misaki Yajima returns to his hometown for the first time in ten years.

He reunites with old friends and looks forward to starting a new life.

One day, his bad-influence friend Kouya Noumi says to him:

“Hey, Misaki! Let’s start a band!”

Kouya suggests forming a band, and Misaki, going along with the flow, joins the light music club.
